not_needed_rules.rationale: Compiler-generated unwind funclet: its address appears only as an unwind-map action of a FuncInfo (magic 0x19930520) that an __ehhandler stub names, and the stub is referenced by exactly one parent function. The funclet runs only while its parent unwinds a C++ exception; it has no behaviour of its own.
deferred_decisions: 460 of the 557 unwind funclets have a game-region parent (they sit in the crt_mfc address band but belong to game functions). Covering them by rule needs an owner or reviewer ruling and, per the plan, the parent must be natively ported or have no native C++ exception path; add "game" to eh_parent_regions only after that ruling, and FL-1 must then check the parent's ledger status.
The 13 Catch@ funclets (all with library parents) are never rule-covered; each is reviewed individually.
machine_preconditions: origin == compiler_eh and eh_kind == unwind (structural, from FuncInfo and the stub; never from names)
exactly one eh_parent, and eh_parent_region in parameters.eh_parent_regions
ledger_preconditions: not listed in semantics_sensitive overrides by VA

not_needed_rules.rationale: Library-band function that no root can reach: nothing calls it, no data or immediate holds its address, the CRT entry function and game code do not reach it through direct edges, and it has no path back into game code. Roots are the CRT entry function, every game-origin function, every address-taken function (data pointer or immediate, excluding exception funclets) and every function of unknown origin.
machine_preconditions: no callers, no data reference, no address-taking immediate
not in the resolved semantics_sensitive set
caveats: Edges out of derived code parts that nothing references are counted as live (over-approximation), so the candidate set can only shrink.
Indirect calls through registers or vtables are covered only by address_taken roots; code that computes a target at run time without an immediate or data pointer is not modelled.
